widget.name: Chat companion
widget.description: Voice input for Conversational UI's message box, and a timed refresh for a live chat.

property.caption: Voice input
property.description: Shows a microphone button that types what the user says into the chat's message box (browser speech recognition). Hidden where the browser has none.

property.caption: Refresh action
property.description: Runs every few seconds while the page is visible, e.g. a microflow that refreshes the chat in the client.

property.caption: Refresh every (seconds)
property.description: How often the refresh action runs.
